lines: Thirty-one lamps and a second bank behind the wall, and on a bad night
we run every one of them.
Aureline does not have more accidents than anywhere else. It just has more people.
Ten at night until six in the morning, and the tin on the counter pays for it.
Foundation offered to fund the night service outright, twice.
We said no, twice. Nobody could tell me why we did and I have stopped asking.
Cart horse Kin. Bad foot. He is eleven and he is not going to work again.
They have not said it yet. I know it and they know I know it.
They are being slow about it on purpose and I am grateful.
Five Crests. You came up the eastern road with five Crests on you.
There are people in this city who have lived here forty years
and never once left it. You have seen more of Caelora than the mayor.
You can train in Aureline your whole life and never fight anyone twice.
Whether that makes you good, I could not honestly tell you.
There is a flower drawn on the screen. I drew it.
The one behind it is asleep and I am not allowed to look.
So I drew the flower so it has something for when it wakes up.
The frightened ones are the hard ones. Hurt you can see. Frightened you cannot.
The leaflet is right. It is not angry with you.
It has just learned that people are a thing that happens to it.
